claims.text: Hemorrhagic shock w refractory hypotension: may be ongoing bleeding or vasodilatory physiology, not pure hypovolemia;
claims.quote: Refractory hypotension in hemorrhagic shock may be due to unrecognized ongoing hemorrhage or to vasodilatory physiology (sympathoinhibitory phase) rather than pure hypovolemia.
